input_and_exact_control_protocol.target: expected randomized F1 and first gradient w.r.t. original pre-temperature scores
input_and_exact_control_protocol.rounding_budget: value_tolerance/max(1,beta); fixed-plan logit gradient error <= total rounding cost

timing.proof: one per-input observation; separate from warm numerical kernel repetitions
timing.headline: best exact warm median / (per-input proof time + approximate warm median)

limits: same fitted models, no new training or predictive superiority claim
scaled scores are input probes, not trained annealing trajectories
conditional rational bounds exclude upstream sigmoid and numerical kernel rounding
numerical gates compare independent Legendre and weighted-Jacobi calculations
first derivatives only; higher-order use unsupported by the strong adjoint control
single-machine bounded timing pilot; setup/proof observations are not confidence intervals
exact zeros/ones are eliminated by the strongest exact control without approximation
no novelty, GPU or universal speed claim

inherited_method_and_controls.candidate: exact grouped binary64 error sums, zero score gradient when accepted, otherwise folded Jacobi
inherited_method_and_controls.timing: entire proof+output in every one of nine warm repetitions; all exact controls retimed in the same run
inherited_method_and_controls.scope: optimization follow-up on the same 144 fitted-model inputs, not fresh-data confirmation
limits: accepted-branch value includes exact float-output conversion error
gradient certificate concerns the zero gradient versus the target first score gradient
fallback quadrature remains numerical and is checked against independent Legendre
upstream sigmoid evaluation, learning, higher derivatives, GPU and novelty unclaimed

protocol.confirmation_gate: all numerical gates pass and pooled beta>=16 geometric speed ratio>=2, including fallback and proof cost
protocol.scope: held-out cost-input seed groups from existing fitted models, not new training or independent new datasets
protocol.parameter_diagnostic: also measure linear-weight gradient error X.T @ score-gradient error; coordinate score bounds alone do not bound this by the same tolerance
